subject: SIG packet: vulnerability management evidence and CVE SLA summary
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@acmepay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acmepay.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: Request: SIG packet — scan cadence evidence + CVE SLA details

Hi Mateo / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the SIG and CAIQ follow-up with us. Audit team flagged a few items we need before the signature window closes for our onboarding:

1) A short CSV (or spreadsheet) listing scan cadence over the last 12 months (scan date, scope, tool, high/critical findings count).
2) A one-page statement of your CVE remediation SLOs (Critical / High / Medium) and any documented exceptions.
3) Any attestations that third-party dependencies are scanned with the same cadence or the compensating controls if not.

If you can share those artifacts (or a pointer to a secure folder) by end-of-day Monday, that will keep our internal SOC review on schedule. If there's a standard attestation doc you prefer we use, please attach it.

We will also need a named contact for a brief QA call (15m) the week of 06/19 to confirm a few line items.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Priya Desai
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Payments

Attachment: acme-sig-questions.pdf (referenced in-line, we may share a preview during the QA call)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@acmepay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 18:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet — scan cadence evidence + CVE SLA details

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. We'll produce the artifacts you asked for. Quick plan from our side: 

- Kimberly will curate the scan index and export the last 12 months as CSV.
- I'll draft the CVE SLA statement and call out exception policy for third-party libs.
- Jonas will validate that scoping includes infra + container images; Monica will pull the patch log and closure timeline.

Proposed deliverables and ETA:
- scan-index CSV, patch-log PDF, and CVE SLA statement by 2028-06-13 EOD (we aim earlier).
- Signed attestation (text file) and links to evidence folder by 2028-06-14 midday.

We can do a 15m QA call on 2028-06-20 between 14:00-15:00 UTC; please let us know a preferred slot.

Action items for us (internal):
- @kimberly: assemble CSV, include tool name and severity counts.
- @monica: pull the remediation tickets and export the patch log.
- @jonas: confirm 3rd-party scanning scope and note any compensating controls.

I'll circulate the folder link once everything is uploaded.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya@acmepay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet — scan cadence evidence + CVE SLA details

Priya / team — attaching the artifacts we agreed to. See the attached stubs below; full files uploaded to the secure evidence folder (link at bottom).

Attachments included (files attached to this thread as stubs):
- redwood_scan-index-2028Q2.csv (CSV; columns: scan_date, scope, tool, high_count, critical_count, notes)
- patch-log-2028Q2.pdf (PDF; remediation ticket list, PR references, closure dates)
- cve-closure-pledge-20280613.txt (signed text attestation)

Key SLA summary (excerpt):
- Critical: initial triage within 24h; mitigation/workaround within 72h; remediation or compensating control within 14 days unless exception is approved.
- High: initial triage within 48h; remediation within 30 days.
- Medium: triage within 5 business days; remediation within 90 days unless deprioritized by risk council.

Third-party dependencies: we scan direct dependencies in CI (Snyk) weekly and perform a monthly SBOM reconciliation for top-level services. For libraries that require vendor coordination, we flag as "third-party-exception" in the patch-log and capture compensating controls (e.g., WAF rule, additional detection, restricted runtime privileges). Jonas confirmed this in the notes appended to the CSV.

Evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.com/sig/evidence/ACME-2028Q2 (access granted to acme@acmepay.com)

If you'd like a signed PDF attestation instead of the text file, we can routable-to-legal and deliver by 2028-06-14 EOD.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_scan-index-2028Q2.csv, patch-log-2028Q2.pdf, cve-closure-pledge-20280613.txt

From: Priya Desai <priya@acmepay.com>

Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acmepay.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: SIG packet — scan cadence evidence + CVE SLA details

Hi Kimberly / Mateo — received, thanks. The CSV and patch-log look good at a glance. Two quick asks before we mark the item as closed in our tracker: 

1) Can you add a single-row summary in the CSV header documenting the scan coverage (percentage of hosts/applications scanned each month) so our compliance team can ingest easily?
2) For third-party exceptions, can you attach one anonymized example ticket showing the compensating controls (no PII or vendor credentials) so we can validate the control design?

The attestation text file is okay for now — if you can route a signed PDF afterwards that would be helpful. We'll schedule the 15m QA call for 2028-06-20 14:15 UTC; please confirm availability.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this helps us meet our internal onboarding SLA.

Best,
Priya
Senior InfoSec Manager, Acme Payments
